topic: the last Ottoman sultan's secret 1922 escape aboard a British warship, hours after his own parliament abolished the sultanate
title: The Ottoman Empire Didn't Fall in Battle. Its Sultan Snuck Out the Back Door.
description: How the 623-year Ottoman Empire actually ended: not a final battle, but its last sultan's secret escape aboard a British warship, hours after his own parliament voted him out. AI-narrated historical commentary -- original script and analysis, not a repost.

hook_candidates.text: An empire's 623-year reign ends not with a battle, but with a sultan's quiet escape.
The Ottoman Empire ruled for 623 years and never actually lost the war that ended it.
How do you end six centuries of empire without losing a single battle?
You think empires collapse in one final battle. This one ended with a sultan's ambulance ride to the docks.

share_trigger: A viewer sends this to the friend who assumes every collapsed empire went down fighting, because they want to show the Ottomans' 600-year run ended with a sultan's quiet escape instead.
contradicted_belief: Most people assume a centuries-old empire's collapse means one final decisive battle, not a sultan's quiet escape.
closing_comment: Wild that a 623-year empire escaped a final battle only to have its own sultan sneak out instead.

sources.note: Confirms the Grand National Assembly abolished the Ottoman sultanate on November 1, 1922.
Confirms Mehmed VI fled Constantinople by British ambulance and warship HMS Malaya on Nov 17, 1922, died in exile in San Remo in 1926.
Confirms the 1924 law permanently banning the entire Ottoman dynasty from Turkey.
